title: Watertight Chest

fields.Container: Static chest, 50 HP. Sturdy requires at least 10 damage per hit. Vulnerable to Bludgeoning, resists Piercing, Necrotic and Radiant, immune to Poison and Psychic.
fields.Contents: Intransigent Warhammer. Chest is on Greymon’s skiff en route to Grymforge.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
